text: Understanding databases is essential for managing data effectively. There are two main types: SQL and NoSQL. SQL databases store information in tables with rows and columns, which makes the data organised and easy to search. To find or change data, you use queries written in a special language. Data modeling helps you plan the structure of your database before you build it, so everything fits together well. Indexes are also important because they speed up searches, especially when tables contain a lot of information. NoSQL databases, on the other hand, are more flexible and store data differently. Choosing the right type depends on your needs.
